about:
Stuffed Foods LLC operates from Wilmington, Massachusetts. The company was formed when its management team, drawing on more than 60 years of combined experience in artisan foods, recognized growing demand for scratch-quality shareable appetizers such as meatballs and arancini and launched the business to serve that niche.

The company produces a line of frozen food products including ravioli, veggie burgers, poppers, mac and cheese, arancini, empanadas, and arepas. Production relies on small-batch preparation and scratch-cooking techniques using traditional methods that preserve fresh-ingredient quality. The USDA- and FDA-inspected facility in Wilmington operates under a HACCP plan and undergoes annual audits by Silliker Laboratories.

Stuffed Foods sells primarily into foodservice channels, supplying distributors, restaurants, caterers, and hotels. Its products are also carried by retail grocery outlets.

Management says the business was started to meet demand for scratch-quality appetizers made with fresh, bold ingredients. The company differentiates itself through small-batch production, traditional cooking methods, and a food-safety program that includes USDA/FDA approval, HACCP compliance, and third-party audits.
